bio.text: Frank Ginn, a Republican, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in 2010 and represents District 47, which includes Madison County and parts of Barrow, Clarke and Jackson counties.

Before joining the Senate, Ginn was selected as the first county manager of Franklin County after voters there adopted the county manager form of government in 2000, and he also served as city manager of Royston and of Sugar Hill.
Ginn graduated from the University of Georgia with a B.S. in Agricultural Engineering in 1985; the legislature biography says he works as a consulting engineer.
